title: Live validation of screen-then-activate group-disjoint control pairing
interpretation: PASS (authoritative, with caveats): fill 6/6 with 6 triggers in scope and 6 group-disjoint complete pairs; E0-E9 pass, 0 ENGINEERING findings (5 DATA_SOURCE: one-sided books at screening; 143 OK). 71 screened (34 triggered, 32 untriggered, 5 unavailable); 6 triggered and 6 control activated; 12/12 role states agree. Validates the screen-then-activate group-disjoint pairing MECHANISM live, once, across categories. Run once: says nothing about fill reliability. Pairs are not independent observations (one run, shared run-level shocks); group-disjoint means separate events, not economic independence (economic_group_status unresolved). No predictive, calibration, prevalence, effect or population claim.

outcome_reasons: fill 6/6 with 6 triggers in scope and 6 group-disjoint complete pairs
